title: RIM-* items
summary: Specifications, current warehouse stock levels, and purchasing records for the RIM-* bicycle rim item family.
body:
The RIM-* item family comprises standard and double-wall aluminium bicycle rims across wheel sizes from 20 to 29 inches[^r1][^r2][^r9]. Inventory is maintained primarily at WH-MAN-STR, with additional stock for select double-wall variants held at WH-LDS-STR[^r2][^r9]. Open procurement and recent purchase orders for the family are sourced from supplier CAW-CHA-0146 Canalside Alloy Wheels Co., Ltd.[^r10][^r11][^r12]

| Property | Details |
|---|---|
| Family code | RIM-* |
| Category | Wheel components |
| Primary warehouse | WH-MAN-STR |
| Secondary warehouse | WH-LDS-STR |
| Active suppliers | CAW-CHA-0146 |

## Stock on hand

Stock levels as recorded in the [[data-stock-on-hand|Stock on hand]] snapshot at 09:00 on 26 October 2026:

* **RIM-20-AL**: WH-MAN-STR holds 573 units on hand, 170 allocated, and 0 on order[^r1].
* **RIM-20-AL-DW**: WH-MAN-STR holds 30,985 units on hand (548 allocated, 0 on order); WH-LDS-STR holds 5,073 units on hand (0 allocated, 0 on order)[^r2].
* **RIM-24-AL**: WH-MAN-STR holds 7,610 units on hand, 197 allocated, and 4,000 on order[^r3].
* **RIM-24-AL-DW**: WH-MAN-STR holds 952 units on hand, 77 allocated, and 0 on order[^r4].
* **RIM-26-AL**: WH-MAN-STR holds 513 units on hand, 6 allocated, and 0 on order[^r5].
* **RIM-26-AL-DW**: WH-MAN-STR holds 2,756 units on hand, 99 allocated, and 0 on order[^r6].
* **RIM-27.5-AL**: WH-MAN-STR holds 36 units on hand and 0 allocated[^r7].
* **RIM-27.5-AL-DW**: WH-MAN-STR holds 3,097 units on hand, 323 allocated, and 0 on order[^r7].
* **RIM-28-AL**: WH-MAN-STR holds 1,018 units on hand and 65 allocated[^r8].
* **RIM-28-AL-DW**: WH-MAN-STR holds 3,824 units on hand and 268 allocated[^r8].
* **RIM-29-AL**: WH-MAN-STR holds 15,150 units on hand, 2,511 allocated, and 0 on order[^r9].
* **RIM-29-AL-DW**: WH-MAN-STR holds 164 units on hand (64 allocated, 400 on order); WH-LDS-STR holds 303 units on hand (0 allocated)[^r9].

## Purchasing and orders

Procurement transactions recorded in the [[data-po-extract-2026|PO extract]] and open order reports include:

* On 2026-08-31, purchase order PO/2026/01097 was placed for 1,600 units of double-wall rim RIM-26-AL-DW with supplier CAW-CHA-0146 at £33.64 each, totalling £53,824 basic value[^r10].
* On 2026-08-31, purchase order PO/2026/01098 was placed for 12,000 units of rim RIM-24-AL with supplier CAW-CHA-0146 at £13.19 each, totalling £158,280 basic value[^r11].
* As of 2026-10-23, item RIM-24-AL remains on open released purchase order PO/2026/01098 for 12,000 units with CAW-CHA-0146 Canalside Alloy Wheels Co., Ltd., scheduled against a need date of 2026-09-14[^r12].
